title: VP, Senior AML Expert Statistician Officer

cond_0001.intro:
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will work under the supervision of a Functional Team Manager to provide ongoing support in terms of required analysis.
The scope of analysis will cover all aspects of analysis performed by the team within different projects: Optimization, Segmentation, Tactical Tuning tasks, and data modeling/validation efforts depending on current needs and project plans.
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology, but is expected to have a high level of initiative and creativity and suggest enhancements to the current methodologies.
Requirements include a background in statistics and/or mathematics (including experience in predictive modeling), preferably also experience with data analysis and/or data science. Experience and knowledge in banking and finance will be desirable, as well as the ability to read and create formal statistical documentation.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Prepare and validate data, and then build and validate a scoring model using logistic regression or alternative quantitative/ machine learning methods.
Conduct data-driven analysis and create reports.
Apply quantitative and qualitative data analysis methods; prepare statistical and non-statistical data exploration.
Validate data, identify data quality issues (if any), and work with Technology to address them.
Analyze and interpret data reports, draw conclusions and make recommendations answering specific business needs.
Document solutions and present results in a simple comprehensive way to non-technical audience, as well as write more formal documentation using statistical vocabulary.
Generate new ideas, concepts and models to improve methods of obtaining and evaluating quantitative and qualitative data.
Identify relationships and trends in data, as well as any factors that could affect the results of research.
Question and validate assumptions.
Escalate identified risks and sensitive areas in terms of methodology and processes.
Maintain an industry leading knowledge of the tools, systems and processes available for best in class AML Detection and Monitoring Operations.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of relevant experience with a strong statistical academic background and knowledge of quantitative methods, including predictive modeling techniques.
Experience in creating and assessing statistical models.
Highly-skilled and good working knowledge of Python/SAS & MS Office Suite.
Experience in reporting the results of analysis in clear written form, and in presenting findings during meetings and conference calls.
Ability to manipulate data using SQL or equivalent.
Bachelor's degree (4-year university) in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Preferred Requirements
Team working experience (demonstrated team player ability).
Understanding of technical requirements, ability to communicate with Technical Support.
Experience with data exploration.
[Product name masked] and AML monitoring systems experience or other transaction monitoring systems.
Knowledge of local/regional laws and regulations applicable to anti-money laundering.
Previous experience with financial services companies (retail banking, small business banking, commercial, institutional, private banking).
Knowledge of any programming language or dedicated statistical software.
Master's degree.
Skills:
Statistical/data analytical skills - including both calculation and interpretation of outcome.
Methodical analysis and problem-solving skills.
Initiative, creativity and attention to detail are essential.
Ability to work under close supervision of a functional team manager, while preserving independence of thinking and responsibility for the results.
Ability to discuss reasoning, critical assessment of facts and opinions; ability of giving comprehensive answers and arguments.
Conceptual and creative thinking (outside the box).
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, through all levels of the organization and through different business units.
Self-motivated with high desire of self-development and learning.
Must be able to coordinate and deal with conflicting time demands.
Competencies:
Very good written and verbal communication ability in an educational style. Ability to express thoughts and concepts clearly.
Teamwork: Ability to work well with a variety of people and to show team-player attitude regardless the scope of responsibilities.
Creativity: Provide input into the innovation of new and enhanced approaches. Having initiative and a proactive attitude is desirable.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0026.intro:
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will take ownership of ongoing analysis under the supervision of a Functional Team Manager.
The scope of analysis covers all aspects of work performed by the team across different projects: Optimization, Segmentation, Tactical Tuning tasks, and data modeling/validation efforts depending on current needs and project plans.
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology, but is expected to exercise a high level of initiative and creativity and drive enhancements to current methodologies.
cond_0026.responsibilities:
Own data preparation and validation, then build and validate scoring models using logistic regression or alternative quantitative/machine learning methods.
Lead data-driven analysis and deliver clear reports.
Execute quantitative and qualitative data analysis methods; direct statistical and non-statistical data exploration.
Validate data, identify data quality issues (if any), and take charge of resolution with Technology.
Analyze and interpret data reports, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that directly address specific business needs.
Document solutions and present results clearly to non-technical audiences, as well as produce formal documentation using statistical vocabulary.
Generate new ideas, concepts, and models to advance methods of obtaining and evaluating quantitative and qualitative data.
Identify relationships and trends in data, as well as any factors that could affect research outcomes.
Challenge and validate assumptions.
Escalate identified risks and sensitive areas in methodology and processes.
Maintain industry-leading knowledge of tools, systems, and processes available for best-in-class AML Detection and Monitoring Operations.
cond_0026.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of relevant experience with a strong statistical background and knowledge of quantitative methods, including predictive modeling techniques.
Experience creating and assessing statistical models.
Strong working knowledge of Python/SAS and MS Office Suite.
Experience reporting analysis results in clear written form and presenting findings in meetings and conference calls.
Ability to manipulate data using SQL or equivalent.
Bachelor's degree (4-year university) in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with data exploration.
[Product name masked] and AML monitoring systems experience, or other transaction monitoring systems.
Knowledge of local/regional laws and regulations applicable to anti-money laundering.
Previous experience with financial services companies (retail banking, small business banking, commercial, institutional, or private banking).
Knowledge of any additional programming language or dedicated statistical software.
Team working experience (demonstrated team player ability).
Understanding of technical requirements and ability to communicate with Technical Support.
Master's degree.

cond_0442.intro:
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will work under the supervision of a Functional Team Manager to provide ongoing support in terms of required analysis.
The scope of analysis will cover all aspects of analysis performed by the team within different projects: Optimization, Segmentation, Tactical Tuning tasks, and data modeling/validation efforts depending on current needs and project plans.
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology, but is expected to have a high level of initiative and creativity and suggest enhancements to the current methodologies.
Requirements include a background in statistics and/or mathematics (including experience in predictive modeling), preferably also experience with data analysis and/or data science. Experience and knowledge in banking and finance will be desirable, as well as the ability to read and create formal statistical documentation.

Prepare and validate data, and then build and validate a scoring model using logistic regression or alternative quantitative/ machine learning methods.

Identify relationships and trends in data, as well as any factors that could affect the results of research.
Question and validate assumptions.

The scope of analysis will cover all aspects of analysis performed by the team within different projects: Optimization, Segmentation, Tactical Tuning tasks, and data modeling/validation efforts depending on current needs and project plans.
The AML Senior Expert Statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology, but is expected to have a high level of initiative and creativity and suggest enhancements to the current methodologies.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of statistical modeling and data-driven analysis.
cond_0535.responsibilities: Prepare and validate data, and then build and validate a scoring model using logistic regression or alternative quantitative/ machine learning methods. Conduct data-driven analysis and create reports. Apply quantitative and qualitative data analysis methods; prepare statistical and non-statistical data exploration. Validate data, identify data quality issues (if any), and work with Technology to address them. Analyze and interpret data reports, draw conclusions and make recommendations answering specific business needs. Document solutions and present results in a simple comprehensive way to non-technical audience, as well as write more formal documentation using statistical vocabulary. Generate new ideas, concepts and models to improve methods of obtaining and evaluating quantitative and qualitative data. Identify relationships and trends in data, as well as any factors that could affect the results of research. Question and validate assumptions. Escalate identified risks and sensitive areas in terms of methodology and processes. Maintain an industry leading knowledge of the tools, systems and processes available for best in class AML Detection and Monitoring Operations.
cond_0535.requirements:
3+ Years of relevant experience in strong statistical academic background, knowledge of quantitative methods, including predictive modeling techniques.
Experience in creating and assessing Statistical Models.
Highly-skilled and good working knowledge of Python/ SAS & MS Office Suite.
Experience in reporting the results of analysis in clear written form, and in presenting the findings during meetings and conference calls.
Team working experience (demonstrated team player ability required).
Understanding of technical requirements, ability to communicate with Technical Support.
Ability to manipulate data using SQL or equivalent.
Experience with data exploration.
[Product name masked] and AML monitoring systems experience or other transaction monitoring systems a plus.
Knowledge of the local/regional laws and regulations applicable to anti-money laundering a plus.
Previous experience with financial services companies (retail banking, small business banking, commercial, institutional, private banking).
Knowledge of any programming language or dedicated statistical software would be an advantage.
Statistical/data analytical skills - including both calculation and interpretation of outcome.
Methodical analysis and problem-solving skills.
Initiative, creativity and attention to detail are essential.
Ability to work under close supervision of a functional team manager, while preserving independence of thinking and responsibility for the results.
Ability to discuss reasoning, critical assessment of facts and opinions; ability of giving comprehensive answers and arguments.
Conceptual and creative thinking (outside the box).
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, through all levels of the organization and through different business units.
Self-motivated with high desire of self-development and learning.
Must be able to coordinate and deal with conflicting time demands.
Very good written and verbal communication ability in an educational style. Ability to express thoughts and concepts clearly.
Teamwork: Ability to work well with a variety of people and to show team-player attitude regardless the scope of responsibilities.
Creativity: Provide input into the innovation of new and enhanced approaches. Having initiative and a proactive attitude is desirable.
Bachelors (4 Year University) Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or related quantitative fields required.
Master Degree preferred.
cond_0535.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, and inclusive benefits. We want employees from different backgrounds to feel supported and able to thrive.
